panels.caption: Neo-Kanda, 2077. Rain on neon, and a city that never once looked up.
Six floors below it, Taro had been awake for four days.
The ring drew more power than the whole district. He threw the lever anyway.
And it opened. A hole in the year, humming like a struck bell.
Then the field folded. The lab tore loose around him.
He landed in wet green air, sixty-six million years from the lever.
The remote still worked. It simply had nothing here to hold on to — the magnetic field was all wrong.
So: find whatever in this age is strong enough to steady it. Then go home.
